ios.desc:
AI Calendar Scanner snap any poster, flyer, or screenshot and Calendarco turns it into a calendar event in seconds. Share via .ics or QR. Batch & recurring events.

Stop typing event details by hand. Calendarco's AI reads posters, flyers, invites, and screenshots then drops the event straight into your calendar. Export as .ics for universal compatibility, or share instantly with a QR code. Built for single events and full batch schedules like classes, festivals, and recurring meetups.

Why people use Calendarco:
  • extract title, date, time, location, and notes from any image
  • .ICS Export: works with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook, Fantastical, and every major calendar app
  • QR Code Sharing: share events instantly; anyone with a phone can add them
  • Batch Events:  scan once, add a whole series of dates or sessions
  • Smart Recurrence: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or custom repeats
  • No accounts, no clutter: open, scan, save

How it works:
  1. Snap a flyer or import an image (or just input manually)
  2. Save to your calendar, export .ics, or share via QR

Perfect for: students juggling class schedules, families coordinating activities, community organizers, teachers, event hosts, and anyone who keeps finding events on paper, screens, or social media.

Turn every poster into a plan. Download Calendarco.

quotes.text:
I have been working on Calendarco for quite some time now, mainly because I use it myself. When I realised other people might make some use of it, I decided to publish it.

About the app, it has 2 main features:

- Batch QR code/.ics file event sharing - https://imgur.com/a/eBoTj46 - create events, export them, share them. Share either via QR code (shown in linked video) or as .ics file. Both of these methods should work on all platforms which use Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Apple Calendar, Proton Calendar and fair amount of other popular calendar apps.

- Extract event or batch events from image - https://imgur.com/a/AexGQbw - take a photo / choose from gallery / paste from clipboard, and let ChatGPT extract events for you. You can import them and edit them.

You can combine these two features too - extract events from images and share them using QR code.

QR Code sharing and extracting events from image are paid features, since they can produce some cost at scale. Rest is free for use.

Try it here https://apps.apple.com/app/calendarco-event-scanner/id6504715509?platform=iphone

Please let me know what you think!

quotes.text:
While searching for some travel options from agencies, I noticed that their timeline of different places mostly one big chunk of text which is not very readable. Then I got idea to create tool to generate batch events, and make that batch shareable via QR code, or via .ics file using native sharing system.

It might come in handy to anyone who would like to share some events straight to other people’s calendars, in my example that would be travellers with some travel agency, e.g. “Rome sightseeing, 15:00 - 18:00”, “Florence walk, 21:00-23:00”.

Also another example for soccer fans, you can create batch events for when your team is playing in the Champions league and easily share it to calendars of other fans. Possibilities are endless :)

Any feedback is welcome!
